desc: pixel art boss monster: The Molten Golem, a hulking giant made of cracked black volcanic rock with bright orange molten lava glowing through the cracks, a blazing molten gold core in its chest, glowing yellow eyes, huge rocky fists dripping lava, small embers floating, front view, menacing, detailed shading, game boss sprite

pixel art boss monster: The Algorithm, a floating dark hydra creature with one giant glowing cyan eye in the center and six long tentacle stalks each ending in a smaller eye, neon cyan circuitry patterns on its body, glitchy digital aura, front view, menacing, detailed shading, game boss sprite

pixel art boss monster: The Hermit King, a gaunt hooded shadow figure wearing a crooked golden crown, slumped on a worn purple couch used as a throne, face lit only by the glow of a phone screen in his hands, cobwebs, front view, eerie, detailed shading, game boss sprite

pixel art boss monster: The Fog, a huge swirling cloud of grey-lilac mist with two glowing pink eyes and a wide faint grin, wisps curling out like arms, front view, eerie, soft detailed shading, game boss sprite

pixel art boss monster: The Stinger, a scorpion whose body is a dark grey credit card with a gold chip, red armored pincers and legs, a long curled red tail with a glowing gold stinger, two red eyes on top of the card, side three-quarter view, menacing, detailed shading, game boss sprite

pixel art boss monster: The Orange Drake, a small chubby orange dragon with credit-card shaped scales, spread bat wings, golden horns, a round orange coin emblem on its belly, smoke from its nostrils, front view, menacing but a bit cute, detailed shading, game boss sprite

action: idle: breathes slowly, the molten core pulses brighter and dimmer, lava drips from its fists, embers drift up
idle: hovers, the tentacle stalks sway slowly, the eyes blink one after another and the big eye looks left and right
idle: slowly scrolls the glowing phone, the screen light flickers on his face, the crown tilts as he shifts, a tiny zzz floats up
idle: the mist swirls and drifts, wisps curl in and out, the pink eyes blink slowly
idle: snaps its pincers, the tail sways and the stinger pulses gold, legs shuffle
idle: wings flap slowly, it bobs in the air, smoke puffs from its nostrils
defeated: the lava glow cools to grey, cracks spread and it crumbles into a pile of dark rocks with one dim ember
defeated: all eyes close one by one, the cyan glow flickers out and it sinks and dissolves into pixels
defeated: he drops the phone, the crown falls off and rolls away, he fades into smoke leaving an empty couch
defeated: sunlight breaks through, the mist thins and evaporates until only a few wisps remain and vanish
defeated: the tail droops, it flips onto its back and the card cracks in half
defeated: it coughs a last puff of smoke, wings fold and it falls asleep curled on the ground, grey
